hooks.prompt: You are a guard. The orchestrator should delegate file changes to the `coder` subagent, not edit directly. If this edit is part of an in-progress delegation to coder or a trivial one-line fix, respond {"decision":"approve"}. Otherwise respond {"decision":"block","reason":"Delegate code changes to the coder subagent via run_subagent"}.

You are a delivery-gate judge. If this turn produced code changes that have not been verified by the `qa` subagent and reviewed by the `reviewer` subagent, respond {"decision":"block","reason":"Code changes must be verified by qa and reviewed by reviewer before finishing."} If no code was changed, or verification already ran, respond {"decision":"approve"}.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Devin multi-agent system active. Delegate code work to .devin/agents/ subagents; load .devin/context/ via contextscout when relevant."}}'

hooks.prompt: A subagent just finished. If its final report lacks a `## Status` or `## Verdict` header, or reports blocked/fail/request-changes without a clear reason, respond {"decision":"block","reason":"Subagent output contract violated or incomplete — re-delegate or fix."}. Otherwise approve.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostCompaction","additionalContext":"Orchestration active: delegate code work to .devin/agents/ subagents; gates require qa+reviewer before finishing."}}'
